'''Muuta''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]], who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Muuta was still a child and she lived with her parents in the [[Darkside (sector)|Darkside]] district of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. When the roof of their housing unit collapsed in, Muuta was trapped and the [[Heroes of Cularin]] attempted to rescue her.
